native.supportLimit: Package discovery proves only that the skill bundle exists. Only a supported model host can expose the active Computer Use tool, and permission is still required before changing an app.

browser-js.supportLimit: A package, executable, or MCP configuration on disk does not prove browser binaries are installed or that a Playwright tool is active in the current model session.

browser-rust.provider: Microsoft sidecar by default; padamson direct binding only by explicit choice
browser-rust.default: Run official Playwright JavaScript/TypeScript black-box automation against the Rust application.

sources.provenance: Microsoft closed official Rust support as not planned; commit pins the official Playwright source used for the sidecar route
Primary repository and release tag, statically audited at the exact commit

browser-rust.supportLimit: Microsoft does not support a Rust Playwright binding. The optional direct binding is third-party and its Cargo build downloads pinned Playwright and Node archives over HTTPS without verifying artifact digests. It is never installed automatically.

agents.role: Split independent native, browser, test, and security work and collect evidence.
Review visible interaction, focus, layout, and accessibility when the controlled surface is a UI.
Verify browser flows, failures, boundaries, and repeatability.
Review untrusted screen content, permissions, secrets, downloads, and control boundaries.

agentLoading: Reference these roles in every harness, but load a full agent definition only when its role fits the current task.
